# weblate_role (Data Source)

Reads a Weblate Role by its name, such as one of the built-in Roles like `Administration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weblate_role" "administration" {
  name = "Administration"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Role. Role names are unique.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the Role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Codes of the permissions the Role grants, such as `project.edit`.
